bio: Biagio has transformed from a weathered mariner into a calculating merchant prince who now commands respect in Venice's cittadini circles through his accumulated wealth and strategic warehouse operations. His southern origins have been tempered by Venetian sophistication, yet he remains fiercely protective of his hard-earned status and quick to perceive slights against his honor.
